release_notes: Outluk Panel 1.0.3: waiting for SOOP verification email is 60 seconds (EMAIL_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC). If IMAP works but no SOOP mail arrives, the account becomes «Письмо не пришло» (email_not_received) and the batch continues. IMAP failures are imap_error. Recheck mail from the context menu without starting a new registration.
